from build123d import *

outer_diameter = 20.7
inner_diameter = 12.1
length = 80.0
taper_length = 30.0
taper_ratio = 0.6
counterbore_diameter = 17.3
counterbore_depth = 10.3
chamfer_size = 0.8
slot_width = 4.0
slot_depth = 6.0
slot_offset = 20.0
mount_hole_diameter = 3.0
mount_hole_spacing = 30.0
mount_hole_offset = 15.0

outer_radius = outer_diameter / 2.0
inner_radius = inner_diameter / 2.0
taper_outer_radius = outer_radius * taper_ratio
taper_inner_radius = inner_radius * taper_ratio

with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((outer_radius, 0), (taper_outer_radius, taper_length))
            l2 = Line(l1@1, (outer_radius, length))
            l3 = Line(l2@1, (0, length))
            l4 = Line(l3@1, (0, 0))
            l5 = Line(l4@1, (outer_radius, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Y)

solid_body = p.part

with BuildPart() as p2:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk2:
        with BuildLine() as bl2:
            l1 = Line((inner_radius, 0), (taper_inner_radius, taper_length))
            l2 = Line(l1@1, (inner_radius, length))
            l3 = Line(l2@1, (0, length))
            l4 = Line(l3@1, (0, 0))
            l5 = Line(l4@1, (inner_radius, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Y)

solid_body = solid_body - p2.part

solid_body = solid_body - Pos(0, length - counterbore_depth/2, 0) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(counterbore_diameter/2, counterbore_depth)

top_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Y)[-1]
solid_body = chamfer(top_face.edges(), chamfer_size)

bottom_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Y)[0]
solid_body = chamfer(bottom_face.edges(), chamfer_size)

solid_body = solid_body - Pos(0, slot_offset, 0) * Box(slot_width, slot_depth, outer_diameter * 2)

for x in [-mount_hole_spacing/2, mount_hole_spacing/2]:
    solid_body = solid_body - Pos(x, mount_hole_offset, 0) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(mount_hole_diameter/2, outer_diameter * 2)

part = solid_body
part.name = "tapered_hollow_cylinder"
